# Final m=9 aggregate-row certificates

The three final rows are split first by `g`, the number of witness-root-to-C
holes. The `g=1,2` cells are single shards; `g=0` is partitioned by exact
internal-B hole count `hB=0,...,k`. All 25 shards were independently accepted
by the pinned LRAT checker.

The four `g=1,2` hashes for k=5 are:

|rho|k|g|CNF SHA-256|LRAT SHA-256|
|---:|---:|---:|---|---|
|0|5|1|`9eed73ca7260c2f6724b7aa15401dda7cc42159446b4833f356904792ab63638`|`2a1bc3b8c5b6e34b9d9406d9b54617abfddf414c5c19d97e8d0a24d45e88e962`|
|0|5|2|`266ac8d44462f221388dcc9c0a36380297f73711649845470dc7df0ab0ac0de7`|`5497e43faffc9e2d806dab32c009909a7ff0e0f0f7ea5c113abfb2b8cf7a473b`|
|1|5|1|`84f0720c4361ea447cb8dbf7033aca93509dce84d6d5a51214c7d929ac4b92bc`|`313d3a51a73df3c479b4f49e99e6aba6fa560ec9faf7c153b8733fb8f9cbf245`|
|1|5|2|`f634cc0049b19fe8c469432b0adab409c50f8033b757c78d02f9f9fb29b6cf9b`|`d8ca60ab812d73a880bd4769e0336c07f11034ae89370b383a1638d8a67a3e9d`|

The earlier tick-30 execution ledger did not survive in the repository. The 19
`g=0` cells are recorded below.

Fresh 2026-07-28 regeneration repaired that missing hash record. CaDiCaL 1.7.3
(source `38e073b389a877b0a0d3c91136d2443ab95fdeba`, local binary SHA-256
`5d8bdcbe5ac3dd205fc40b040f908565c1f3bafde8a838664c8c4189fd93ec1c`)
returned exit 20, and `lrat-check` from source
`2e3b2dc0ecf938addbd779d42877b6ed69d9a985` (binary SHA-256
`e9e71c96b68dc9ed22db35d7581e613e6b161ffbc82c20cba5699f8320a065b8`)
returned `c VERIFIED` for both:

|rho|k|g|CNF bytes|CNF SHA-256|LRAT bytes|LRAT SHA-256|
|---:|---:|---:|---:|---|---:|---|
|0|6|1|11202979|`0bf01d932b1ec0a5c36a6880e7a42eb34a988242966ec8e92efe031f355cb340`|1507416864|`76f530d17755cb16f440341790361a8b746d261668e21b2a6c885c9dea90dccd`|
|0|6|2|11202970|`bc4a835d58e2fd3f857869678f848d9b7204b29f49f2a6b926c44b7cc96753fd`|2913396085|`3993f8a7d5849944bf2a7eb768ca59d3c90e0e71b8fe81d0cfbf864e620c6c6b`|

The proof bytes were independently checked but are too large for ordinary Git
and have not yet been placed in immutable content-addressed storage. Therefore
these remain reproducible checked-run records, not presently downloadable
certificates. The deterministic CNFs are regenerated by
`m9-final-shards.py 0 6 G OUTPUT`.
